title: Dxcufgb's Session Summary
description: Records your play session on the GM's client: killing blows per character, damage, healing, heroes dropping to 0 HP, fights and rounds, rests, distance walked, the scenes the party spent time in, and every player's dice (1s and max results per die type, natural 20s and 1s). When the GM ends the session, a JSON summary and a Discord-ready Markdown text are written to the Data folder for a bot on the same computer to post.

recommends.reason: Optional. Its GM damage card tells exactly who landed each killing blow.
